title: Second derivatives of $p$-adic $L$-functions and the Shafarevich--Tate group of rank-two CM elliptic curves
summary: For an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$ of rank two with complex multiplication, Coates, Liang and Sujatha gave a criterion for the vanishing of $Sha(E/\mathbb{Q})[p^\infty]$ at a good ordinary prime $p$ and applied it to five such curves for $p < 30{,}000$. We prove a cyclotomic criterion of the same kind: outside an explicit set of primes, the normalised second Taylor coefficient of the Mazur-Tate-Teitelbaum $p$-adic $L$-function at the central point is a $p$-adic unit if and only if the cyclotomic $p$-adic regulator is a unit and $Sha(E/\mathbb{Q})[p^\infty] = 0$, and, by the theory of…
